description: Calculate Quebec provincial income tax (Revenu Québec) with the basic personal amount credited at the lowest rate. Excludes employment-specific credits (QPP/QPIP/EI, worker deduction): for a salary use calculate_canada_combined_tax. Returns: {income_cad, basic_personal_amount, basic_personal_credit, taxable_income, provincial_tax, effective_rate_pct, marginal_rate_pct, ...}. See list_bundles for related 'finance-afrique-quebec' calculators.
